Totally Psychotic Woman Starts Taking Photos Of Doordash Delivery Man, Ends Up Assaulting Him For No Reason At All
This mentally ill woman keeps coming in and out of her apartment, looking oddly at a DoorDash deliveryman waiting to get paid for a pizza. She then starts taking photos of him, even taking photos of his face, up close and personal. When he questions why she is taking his photo, she knocks the pizza out of his hands, not once, but twice. She then invited him into her apartment so she could assault him.
The cops were called, and the mental case was arrested.
